source: bonjour construit tu peut me faire une tour mais au début c'est les mur sont rouge on haut du mur rouge tu peut mettre un mur orange on haut du mur orange tu peut me mettre un mur jaune

image_prompt.text: A tall tower of stacked walls visible from a distance - red walls at the base, orange walls above them, yellow walls at the top
A walkable route around the base of the tower
A vantage point composed to look back at the full height of the colour banding

notes: No game type is named - this is a structure request, so stage A lands on None and all five axes stay at their defaults.
If the tower is meant to be entered or climbed, the vertical axis becomes stacked and the route becomes P2; as written it is a solid structure on a single surface.

open_questions.ask: Beyond the red, orange and yellow walls, what should the tower be made of - stone, brick, plain blocks?
Do you go inside or climb the tower, or is it a structure to look at?
How tall should it be, and how many walls high is each colour band?

coverage_missing.ask: Is the tower enterable or climbable, or purely a structure to look at?
How tall is the tower and how many walls make up each colour band?
Is this part of a game, or just the build?

answers.ask: Beyond the red, orange and yellow walls, what should the tower be made of - stone, brick, plain blocks?
answers.answer: Fais-la avec de simples blocs, avec les murs colorés rouge en bas, orange au-dessus et jaune tout en haut.

answers.ask: Do you go inside or climb the tower, or is it a structure to look at?
answers.answer: C'est une structure à regarder, sans intérieur ni escalade.

answers.ask: How tall should it be, and how many walls high is each colour band?
answers.answer: Fais une petite tour de 9 murs de haut : 3 murs rouges en bas, 3 murs orange au milieu et 3 murs jaunes en haut.
